answer: Identity costs two things up front. First, a bonded deposit locked per key and slashable if clustering flags correlated control. Second, device attestation signed with a unique hardware quill over the epoch randomness beacon, so one machine mints one identity. Riding a thousand sybils means funding a thousand refundable-only-on-good-behavior deposits and a thousand distinct attested devices, and fabricated keys burn real timber, not ink.
